snippet.title: POLYARIS – Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
RELEASE DATE: January 19, 2027
Wishlist POLYARIS on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2979810/POLYARIS/

The wait is almost over. POLYARIS officially launches into 1.0 on January 19, 2027

A nuclear explosion. A crashed plane. An abandoned Arctic wilderness.
POLYARIS is a first-person Arctic survival game where the cold is deadlier than any enemy. Explore on skis and by boat, scavenge supplies, manage your warmth, food and water, face deadly wildlife, and uncover the secrets of the desolate North.

FEATURES:
- Story Mode and Endless Survival
- Unique skiing and boat navigation
- Comprehensive winter survival mechanics
- Fishing, crafting, and exploration
- Wolves, polar bears, and hostile scavengers
- Four difficulty levels inspired by Arctic cycles, plus customizable settings

#POLYARIS #SurvivalGame #IndieGame #ArcticSurvival
